title: DR1 picks the country of origin by typing into a search box that offers matches as you type; the frontend makes the user open a dropdown and scroll a fixed list.

finding.frontend: Country of origin is a govukSelect. The closed control reads 'Select a country' and opening it gives one long alphabetical list with a divider rule under the placeholder. There is no way to type. The user scrolls (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/origin/template.njk:15-22).
finding.prototype: DR1 renders a search input with the placeholder 'Search for a country' and a magnifying-glass button. Typing filters a results list that appears under the box, and choosing a result writes the country into a hidden field; a live region announces the match count to screen readers. The list it searches carries regions as well as states, so 'Spain' surfaces Spain, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla together (app/views/origin-of-the-import.html:53-98).
finding.difference: Replace the select with the same search-and-choose control DR1 uses. The frontend already has to grow the underlying list to match DR1, so do that first — a search box over 31 entries buys less than a search box over the 41 DR1 offers. Keep a no-JavaScript fallback: DR1's control degrades to a bare text input, which the real service cannot ship, so the fallback has to be a select or a server-rendered results page.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that DR1's country of origin renders as a plain select for a DR1 session, with the search module mounted only under a design-release-2 flag.
finding.correction: Verified sound on both sides, from the pictures and the markup. evidence/frontend@76a864ba/page/fe-origin.png shows a closed govukSelect reading 'Select a country'; evidence/prototype@491b3926/page/dr1-origin-of-the-import.png shows a text input with the placeholder 'Search for a country' and a blue magnifying-glass button. The root DR1 view mounts the search module unconditionally — data-module='app-country-search' at app/views/origin-of-the-import.html:55, the country data and prefix data inlined as JSON at :57-58, the hidden value field at :94 and the aria-live status region at :97 — so the falsifier does not fire: there is no design-release branch on that control. The frontend's captured select carries the placeholder, a disabled divider rule and 31 options and no text entry of any kind. HOW CHECKED: read both screenshots; read both templates; read the captured DOM for both controls.

relatedTo.why: the control and the list it searches are one piece of work
